question: घोड़ा (Horse) कैसे दौड़ता है? 🐎
explanation: Super star! A horse is very strong and runs very तेज़ (Fast)! 🐎
hint: It does not run like a turtle.

question: इस कविता में किस जानवर (Animal) की बात हो रही है? 🐴
explanation: Yay! The poem is all about a beautiful घोड़ा (Horse)! 🌟
hint: People ride on its back.

question: घोड़े (Horse) के कितने पैर (Legs) होते हैं? 🐾
explanation: Awesome! A horse uses its चार (Four) strong legs to run! 🐾
hint: Count them: 1, 2, 3...

question: घोड़ा (Horse) मज़े से क्या खाता है? 🌾
explanation: Great job! Horses love to eat fresh, green घास (Grass)! 🌱
hint: It is green and grows in the park.

question: घोड़े (Horse) के दौड़ने की आवाज़ (Sound) कैसी होती है? 🎵
explanation: Fantastic! When a horse runs, its hooves go तबड़क तबड़क (Tig-dik)! 🎶
hint: It sounds like a drum beat on the ground.

question: हम घोड़े (Horse) पर क्या करते हैं? 🏇
explanation: Brilliant! We can sit on a horse and go for a fun सवारी (Riding)! 🏇
hint: You do this on a bicycle too.

question: घोड़े (Horse) की पूंछ (Tail) कैसी होती है? 🐎
explanation: Perfect! A horse has a beautiful, flowing, लंबी (Long) tail! ✨
hint: It helps them brush away flies.

question: घोड़ा (Horse) कैसा जानवर (Animal) है? 🐶
explanation: Super star! Horses are very kind and प्यारा (Lovely) friends! 🥰
hint: We love them very much.

question: जब हम घोड़े (Horse) की सवारी करते हैं, तो कैसा लगता है? 😄
explanation: Yay! Riding a horse is so much मज़ा (Fun) and exciting! 🎉
hint: It brings a big smile to your face.

question: घोड़े (Horse) का रंग (Color) कैसा हो सकता है? 🎨
explanation: Awesome! Horses can be black, brown, or white. काला (Black) is a lovely color! 🐴
hint: It is the color of the night sky.

question: क्या घोड़ा (Horse) तेज़ दौड़कर हवा (Wind) से बातें करता है? 🌬️
explanation: Great job! A horse runs so fast it feels like talking to the हवा (Wind)! ⚡
hint: It goes zoom-zoom!

question: घोड़ा (Horse) और क्या खाना पसंद करता है? 😋
explanation: Fantastic! Horses love to munch on healthy चना (Gram)! 🌾
hint: These are small, round, and healthy beans.

question: हमें अपने घोड़े (Horse) से क्या करना चाहिए? 🤝
explanation: Brilliant! Always show kindness and प्यार (Love) to all animals! 💖
hint: Give them a gentle hug.

question: घोड़े (Horse) के कितने कान (Ears) होते हैं? 👂
explanation: Perfect! A horse has दो (Two) cute ears that point up! 🐴
hint: Look at your own head to count.

question: घोड़े (Horse) की कितनी आँखें (Eyes) होती हैं? 👀
explanation: Super star! A horse looks around with its big, beautiful दो (Two) eyes! ✨
hint: You use this number of eyes to see the world.

question: घोड़ा (Horse) अपने पैरों से क्या करता है? 🐾
explanation: Yay! A horse uses its strong legs for दौड़ना (Running) super fast! ⚡
hint: It moves very quickly on the ground.

question: घोड़े (Horse) की पीठ (Back) पर बैठकर हम कहाँ जाते हैं? 🛤️
explanation: Awesome! We can go on a lovely सफर (Journey) riding a horse! 🏞️
hint: It is like a trip or an adventure.

question: घोड़ा (Horse) कहाँ आराम (Rest) करता है? 😴
explanation: Great job! A horse's safe and cozy home is called an अस्तबल (Stable)! 🏚️
hint: It is a special house built just for horses.

question: दौड़ते समय घोड़ा (Horse) कहाँ देखता है? 👀
explanation: Fantastic! A brave horse always looks आगे (Forward) while running! 🌟
hint: It looks straight to see where it is going.

question: क्या घोड़ा (Horse) छलांग (Jump) लगा सकता है? 🦘
explanation: Brilliant! Horses are great athletes and can छलांग (Jump) over fences! 🏇
hint: Kangaroos do this too.

question: घोड़े (Horse) की गर्दन (Neck) पर क्या होते हैं? 🐎
explanation: Perfect! A horse has beautiful, long बाल (Mane) on its neck! ✨
hint: We comb these to make them look neat.

question: हम घोड़े (Horse) को प्यार से कैसे बुलाते हैं? ✋
explanation: Super star! We gently call a horse by पुचकारकर (Petting) it with love! 💕
hint: We make sweet, gentle sounds to our pets.

question: एक और घोड़े (Horse) का रंग (Color) क्या हो सकता है? 🟤
explanation: Yay! Many beautiful horses have a shiny भूरा (Brown) coat! 🐎
hint: It is the color of chocolate.

question: सफेद घोड़े (White Horse) का रंग कैसा होता है? ⚪
explanation: Awesome! A white horse is purely सफेद (White), like a snowy cloud! ☁️
hint: It is the color of milk.

question: घोड़ा (Horse) देखने में कैसा लगता है? 🌟
explanation: Great job! A healthy and happy horse looks very सुंदर (Beautiful)! 😍
hint: It looks very pretty and nice.

question: क्या घोड़ा (Horse) हमारा दोस्त (Friend) बन सकता है? 🤝
explanation: Fantastic! If we love them, animals become our best दोस्त (Friend)! 🥰
hint: They love playing with you.

question: घोड़े (Horse) को मीठे में क्या पसंद है? 🍎
explanation: Brilliant! A sweet and crunchy सेब (Apple) is a yummy treat for a horse! 🍏
hint: It is red, round, and sweet.

question: घोड़े (Horse) की आवाज़ (Voice) को क्या कहते हैं? 🗣️
explanation: Perfect! When a horse talks, it makes a हिनहिनाना (Neigh) sound! 🎶
hint: It sounds like 'Neiiiigh'.

question: घोड़ा (Horse) कहाँ दौड़ना पसंद करता है? 🏞️
explanation: Super star! A big, open मैदान (Ground) is the best place to run! 🏃
hint: It has lots of space and green grass.

question: घोड़े (Horse) के खुर (Hooves) से कैसी आवाज़ आती है? ⏱️
explanation: Yay! The hard hooves make a cool टिक-टिक (Tick-tock) sound on the path! 🎵
hint: It sounds like a busy clock.

question: घोड़ा (Horse) किसके समान तेज़ (Fast) भागता है? 🌬️
explanation: Awesome! A racing horse moves as fast as the तेज़ हवा (Wind)! ⚡
hint: You can feel it blowing on your face.

question: घोड़ा (Horse) कैसा होता है? 🦸
explanation: Great job! A horse is very strong, proud, and बहादुर (Brave)! 🌟
hint: It is not scared of running fast.

question: हमें घोड़े (Horse) को कैसा रखना चाहिए? 🧽
explanation: Fantastic! Brushing and washing keeps a horse shiny and साफ (Clean)! 🛁
hint: We wash them so they smell good.

question: दौड़ (Race) में तेज़ घोड़ा (Horse) क्या करता है? 🏆
explanation: Brilliant! The fastest horse loves जीतना (Winning) the race! 🎉
hint: They get the gold medal!

question: घोड़े (Horse) का शरीर (Body) कैसा होता है? 🐘
explanation: Perfect! A horse is a tall and बड़ा (Big) animal with strong muscles! 💪
hint: It is much taller than a dog.

question: जब घोड़ा (Horse) दौड़ता है, तो उसके बाल (Hair) क्या करते हैं? 🌬️
explanation: Super star! In the fast wind, the horse's mane and tail उड़ते (Fly)! ✨
hint: They dance in the air like a kite.

question: क्या हम घोड़े (Horse) के साथ खेल (Play) सकते हैं? ⚽
explanation: Yay! Gentle horses love to खेल (Play) and spend time with us! 💕
hint: It is fun to be with them.

question: घोड़े (Horse) के सिर (Head) पर क्या होता है? 💇
explanation: Awesome! Right between its ears, a horse has lovely बाल (Hair)! ✨
hint: You have this on your head too.

question: घोड़ा (Horse) बहुत _____ होता है। 🧠
explanation: Great job! Horses learn quickly because they are very समझदार (Smart)! 🌟
hint: They know exactly where to go.

question: घोड़े (Horse) को पानी (Water) कब पीना चाहिए? 🚰
explanation: Fantastic! Just like us, animals need fresh water रोज़ (Daily)! 🌊
hint: You drink it every day when you are thirsty.

question: जब घोड़ा (Horse) हमें प्यार करता है, तो वह क्या करता है? 👃
explanation: Brilliant! A gentle horse will lovingly सूंघना (Sniff) your hand! 💕
hint: They use their nose to say hello softly.

question: हम घोड़े (Horse) की सवारी (Ride) कहाँ बैठकर करते हैं? 🏇
explanation: Perfect! We safely sit on the strong पीठ (Back) of the horse! 🎠
hint: It is the large flat part behind its neck.

question: घोड़े (Horse) के प्यारे बच्चे को क्या कहते हैं? 🐴
explanation: Super star! A cute baby horse is called a बछेड़ा (Foal)! ✨
hint: It loves to run around its mommy horse.

question: घोड़ा (Horse) रात में क्या करता है? 🌙
explanation: Yay! At night, horses like to rest and सोना (Sleep) in the stable! 🌟
hint: You do this in your bed at night.

question: घोड़े (Horse) को खाने में कौन सी सब्ज़ी (Vegetable) पसंद है? 🥕
explanation: Awesome! Crunchy, sweet, orange गाजर (Carrot) is a favorite horse treat! 😋
hint: Rabbits also love to eat this orange vegetable.

question: वाह मेरे घोड़े (Horse) कविता (Poem) हमें कैसी लगती है? 📖
explanation: Great job! It is a very happy and अच्छी (Good) poem about a lovely friend! 💖
hint: It makes us feel happy.

question: जब हम घोड़े (Horse) को गाजर (Carrot) देते हैं, तो वह कैसा होता है? 🥕
explanation: Fantastic! Tasty treats make our horse friend very खुश (Happy)! 🎉
hint: You feel this way when you get a chocolate.

question: घोड़ा (Horse) किस दिशा (Direction) में भागता है? 🧭
explanation: Brilliant! To win the race, the horse always runs तेज़ आगे (Forward)! 🏃
hint: It goes straight ahead.

question: घोड़े (Horse) को गर्मी लगने पर कहाँ खड़ा होना चाहिए? ☀️
explanation: Perfect! The cool छाँव (Shade) of a big tree gives the horse rest! 🌿
hint: It is dark and cool under a big tree.

question: घोड़े (Horse) का सवारी करने वाला साथी कौन होता है? 🤝
explanation: Super star! The human friend sitting on the back is called a सवार (Rider)! ✨
hint: It is a person like you or me.
